title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：sum　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sum 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the observer ① checked the sum that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the checking was the whole of the night. The ② sum, meaning the total itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; a sum, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sum in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ sum at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sum, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the observer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sum was the whole of the matter, meaning the share and not the total. The ⑥ sum, meaning the share and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; sum, he said, is either something you check or the only word that means both a total and a share. He said the share is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ sum had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ sum of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of describing; sum, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sum I remember is the total described in the log, which closed in 1986 and is still described as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ sum, my mother said in 1988, is the only total that improves by being described; every sum, she said, is a share that has agreed to look like a total. She said the share was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 总数；金额（指观测站里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 总数；金额（指那笔总数本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：check the sum 核算这一笔总数
D. n. 总数；金额（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 总数之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的总数之事）
F. n. 总数；金额（指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一笔）
G. n. 总数、分量（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 分量（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: checked the sum that no assistant in the observatory would have described
The sum, meaning the total itself and not the lens
the sum at the far dome
the sum was the whole of the matter
the sum had become a line in a log
The sum of the whole thing
A sum, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: check the sum 意为“核算这一笔总数”，1979 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一笔总数做了一遍。
sum 意为“总数；金额”，指那笔总数本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
sum 意为“总数；金额”，指观测站里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
sum 意为“总数；金额”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sum 意为“总数、分量”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔分量就是那件事的全部。
sum 意为“分量”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔总数，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sum 意为“总数；金额”，指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一笔，到 1984 年这一笔成了观测记录里的一行。
sum 意为“总数之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的总数之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的描述。
sum 意为“总数；金额”，我记得的是观测记录里描述过的那一笔，1986 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一笔。
sum 为抽象总称，母亲 1988 年说，总数是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的总数。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年那位观测员核算了观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一笔总数，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（check the sum）
那笔总数，指的是那笔总数本身而不是小小的镜片，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。（sum）
那处观测站里每一笔总数旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。（sum）
最远那座圆顶那笔总数，指的是他们留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（sum）
叔叔说这笔分量就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那笔总数。（sum）
1988 年母亲说，总数是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的总数。（sum）
answers: In 1979 the observer checked the sum that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the checking was the whole of the night.

The sum at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the sum was the whole of the matter, meaning the share and not the total.
